data.one_liner: Retrieve widget screen coordinates and compare positions at runtime
data.what_it_does: Wrap widgets with RenderMetricsObject to expose their RenderData, then query a RenderParametersManager for absolute coordinates or differences between two widgets.
use_when: Need to know widget position for custom layout logic
avoid_when: You only need static layout, not runtime metrics
Performance‑critical code where extra RenderObject traversal is costly
strengths: Provides full coordinate set and diff helpers
weaknesses: Adds a RenderObject layer, may affect performance
No built‑in animation or reactive updates
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, create RenderParametersManager, wrap widgets with RenderMetricsObject
